story: A mythical figure was remembered in different ways by different witnesses: some described him as a building that had been destroyed by foreign conquerors; others said he was the father of a great cat (perhaps a puma or jaguar) that had been attacking travelers on local roads; others called him an idol; and when asked who he was, one witness replied that he was a wind, dwelling at the site of the destroyed building. In a later, more developed account, he became a civilizing hero who descended to earth to found a religion. He appeared first in one town, and later in another town, where the people welcomed him with hospitality. He then retreated into a cave, where many local chiefs came to visit him seeking wisdom. Chiefs from several nearby towns came to consult him. After the supreme being of the people sent them to a particular city, that city became a sacred place, where a great temple dedicated to the sun was built, and religious festivals were organized to commemorate the hero's arrival.
